findings.message: model restricts column "kind" of table "posts" to the values ("a", "b"), but the database does not enforce that: the column's enum type allows ("a", "b", "c")
findings.fix: Restrict column "kind" of table "posts" to the values ("a", "b"): keep the enum in the model, then regenerate the migration so the column becomes a native enum or gets a CHECK listing exactly these values, and apply it.
